name: What role does the real estate agent play in luxury condo closing coordination?

mainEntity.name: What role does the real estate agent play in luxury condo closing coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real estate agent is central to the closing coordination process, serving as the primary point of contact and orchestrating communication among all parties involved. This includes liaising with lenders, title companies, inspectors, attorneys, and the condominium association. Our agents at Realty ONE Group Evolution leverage their experience in the South Florida luxury market to proactively manage tasks and address any issues that arise, ensuring a seamless transaction for clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: The real estate agent manages communication, coordinates parties, and addresses issues to ensure a seamless transaction.
